Package index

Structure

What hangs beneath a plan. The tree is the shape of its ownership; the table is the same thing a planner can sort and open; the grid says which cells are locked and by whom. One subplan keeps one colour across all three.

ec_tree()
Chart the subplan tree
tbl_tree()
A subplan tree as an interactive table
ec_ownership()
Chart which cells a subplan owns

Money

Where the spend sits in the nesting, how one backed cell arrives at its number, and how it moves across a set of scenarios.

ec_sunburst()
Chart spend by nesting
ec_rollup()
Chart how a backed cell adds up
ec_compare()
Chart how spend moves across a set of scenarios

Lineage

Where a scenario came from. Each one measured against the plan it was actually derived from, which is what makes a chain read as a chain.

ec_lineage()
Chart a scenario set's lineage

The spec

Every chart function returns a spec – a plain list holding an ECharts option. Send it as JSON, or draw it as a widget.

new_spec()
A chart specification
as_json() as_widget()
Convert a spec to JSON or to a widget
viz_theme()
The colours a spec is built with
